title: ReverseDock agent protocol, version 1 (protocol: rdock)
description: What an `agent` middleware with `protocol: rdock` POSTs to the agent (`request`, with `Content-Type: application/json`) and what the agent answers (`verdict`, status 200, `Content-Type: application/json`). Any other status, or a body that does not match `verdict`, is a failure and follows `on_error`. Unknown fields are ignored in both directions, so later versions can add fields. ADR-0030.

header_values.description: One value, or several values of the same header.

path.description: As the client sent it (after earlier middlewares), percent-encoded.

scheme.description: Whether the client connection uses TLS.

headers.description: The allowed request headers (the default set plus `request_headers`) as [name, value] pairs in order; names are lower-case.

ip.description: The client address rdock resolved (after trusted proxies).

request_id.description: Also sent as `X-Request-ID`, and to the backend.

body.description: The request body (at most `max_body` bytes), or null when the request has none or it is not sent.

body_skipped.description: True when the body was longer than `max_body` and `on_oversize: skip` sent the request without it.

status.description: deny: the status sent to the client.

headers.description: deny: headers of the answer to the client (framing headers are dropped).

body.description: deny: the body of the answer; rdock's standard page for the status when absent.

set_request_headers.description: allow: headers to set on the request that goes to the backend. Only names in the middleware's `response_headers` are applied, and only for requests decided before their head left (requests without a body); others are ignored and counted in `rdock_agent_ignored_headers_total`.
